# cluster settings
service "api" {
  enabled  = true
  port     = 8080
  latency  = -1.5e3
  ratio    = 0.25
  owner    = null
  tags     = ["web", "edge"]
  defaults = { cpu = 2 }
  greeting = "hello ${local.name}!"
  note     = "said \"hi\"\n"
  banner   = <<EOT
    cluster ${local.region} online
    EOT
  toggle   = enabled ? "on" : "off"
  /* trailing note */
}
